messages:
alex: quick coordination check — SOC2 dry run next Wed (2026-06-10). need owners to confirm readiness for: audit-log ingest, retention config, KMS evidence (rotation + access proofs), and HSM attestation docs. pinging @sara @jamie @mike :wave:
sara: I own KMS evidence. will validate rotation logs and key access lists. plan is to produce a short checklist + export by Tue EOD.
jamie: infra side: audit-ingest pipeline is running but retention policy wasn't applied to staging. I can push the retention change Tue AM. question: should logs be JSON-lines or syslog? anyone consuming expect a specific schema?
mike: platform: consumers expect json-lines with these fields: timestamp, level, req_id, user_id (hashed). i'll add a transform to strip any raw PII. PR up: https://git.internal/repo/pr/456 — needs review.
nina: oncall: can review Tue morning. heads-up — I'm PTO Wed-Fri, so if review lands late please reassign.
jamie: noted. small infra blocker: the backfill job needs a 72h quota bump in prod to complete. we need ops approval to open window.
mike: filed ops ticket OPS-789 and linked it in the PR, waiting on approval.
sara: also need the HSM attestation doc updated with the new slot names. draft snippet below — will push full doc tomorrow: ```yaml
keystore: hsm-cluster-02
attestation_date: 2026-06-08
slots: [slot-a, slot-b]
```
alex: ok let's capture owners + milestones quickly so the compliance tracker can be updated:
- KMS evidence exports + checklist: sara — due Tue EOD
- Audit ingest retention applied to staging/prod: jamie — due Tue AM
- Transform (drop PII) + PR: mike — PR out, review by nina/rachel Tue AM
- HSM attestation doc update: sara — draft Wed AM
- Ops quota for backfill: mike → ops (OPS-789) — approval needed Tue

jamie: can we add a short log validation step after retention change? i can run a sanity query: ```curl -s "https://logs.internal/query?q=limit(5)" | jq .``` — will paste results in thread for audit evidence.
sara: perfect, that query output is fine for evidence. please keep a timestamped snippet.
security-bot: Reminder: dry run scheduled 2026-06-10 10:00 UTC. Attach evidence artifacts to /compliance/dryrun and link here.
rachel: I can take reviews while nina is out. ping me on the PR if it needs attention.
nina: left a quick comment on the PR — nothing blocking, just a nit on the transform config.
mike: thanks — will address the nit and re-request review.
alex: if anyone expects slippage call it out now, otherwise i'll lock these milestones and update the tracker. :thumbsup:
sara: on track. if ops delays quota i'll flag immediately.
jamie: on track pending ops approval.
rachel: ready to help with reviews.
security-bot: Note: attach signed attestation PDF to the evidence folder to complete the HSM artifact requirement.
alex: great — i'll update the tracker and send a one-line status to the compliance channel after Tue AM checks. thanks everyone! :pray:
